answers.core: Security would be the biggest problem if it is implemented wrong by a community member, as well as seamless integration with the already existing HashingContext. Additionally a new game/software developer will be more enticed to use the existing fast hashing methods vs searching for slow one in the asset library, which could lead them into a bad spot if the hashed data needed to be secured.
answers.workaround: At the moment, it would require the developer to create a plugin or something similar to implement such a feature. So no, this cannot be made with a few lines of code.

title: Add password hashing algorithms to HashingContext
